verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card for AI vendor spend, so an expense audit trail is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence covers only rewards rates, partner perks, card request and withdrawal, and there is nothing documenting edit history, approval logs, policy checks or audit-ready records.

support.subject: As a finance lead, every expense carries a full audit trail — edits, approvals, policy checks — that survives an external audit
